title: Pretty Blanket, but Colors Already Ran Through on Sherpa Backing
text: Pretty Blanket, but Colors Already Ran Through on Sherpa Backing. On my couch, I always keep a blanket available and wanted one for the holidays.  This red one seemed perfect until I got it out of the packaging.  The backside of the blanket is basically pink, not cream.  To be honest, it will be fine, as I have pets that ruin anything too nice, but I don't know that I'd purchase this for someone else.  I can't say if other colors run, but the red has definitely bled through before washing.

product_metadata.title: NANPIPER Sherpa Blanket Warm Blankets for Winter Super Soft Fuzzy Flannel Fleece/Wool Like Reversible Velvet Plush Couch Blanket (Wine Red Twin Size 60"x79")
features: ☃️Premium Bed Material: NANPIPER plush bed blanket, made of 100% microfiber, Twin 60"x79". You can take it for traveling, camping or having a nap on sofa/couch or snuggling up when watching TV. Package include 1x Bed blanket (Not Electric).

🤶🏾Soft & Warm: Both sides of the flannel top and Sherpa reverse are soft and warm, so it's a comfortable bed blanket for snuggling up when you have a sleep. If you want to be relaxed on your sofa/beds feeling warm on those freezing days and nights, there is no doubt that this Sherpa blanket is your best choice.

🎅🏾Reversible with Decorative Line Design: The top side is flannel fleece (220gsm) and the bottom is Sherpa (260gsm), you can have two different senses of touch. This throw blanket is bound up with knit-trim edging for ornaments. Whether the rich smooth plush colored side or the beautiful and elegant white Sherpa side, this soft blanket will not disappoint you.

🤶🏽No Shed: The Sherpa blanket is not color fading, so you don't need to worry about the lint. You can also use it for your baby and present it to your family or friends as a birthday gift, valentine's day present, wedding gift and Christmas gift.

🎅🏽Washing Instruction: Machine washable in gentle cycle, tumble dry on low heat. Do not use bleach. Made with shrink-resistant fabric. No matter how many times you wash, this cozy and plush warm Sherpa blanket is shrink resistant and not pilling. We advise that you wash it before the first using in order to remove the excessive lint left over during the manufacturing process.
